description: This Java class defines a configuration object for MongoDB options, specifically handling SSL enablement and read preference settings, and includes methods for instantiation from a configuration object, equality checks, and string representations.

classes.name: DefaultOptionsConfig
classes.description: Immutable class representing MongoDB options configuration, including SSL and read preference settings.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DefaultOptionsConfig from a given Config object.

methods.name: isSslEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether SSL is enabled for MongoDB connection.
